text: Computer vision is a field of technology that helps computers understand images and videos. One important part is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key idea is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in one image. Computer vision has many useful applications in daily life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to help them see the road, recognise traffic signs, and avoid accidents. It is also used in security systems and medical imaging. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more important in the future.
